text.KJV: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;
text.ASV: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,
text.WEB: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones, and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

text.KJV: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;
text.ASV: in hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before times eternal;
text.WEB: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;

text.KJV: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;
text.ASV: but in his own seasons manifested his word in the message, wherewith I was intrusted according to the commandment of God our Saviour;
text.WEB: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior;

text.KJV: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.
text.ASV: to Titus, my true child after a common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Saviour.
text.WEB: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.

text.KJV: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:
text.ASV: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that were wanting, and appoint elders in every city, as I gave thee charge;
text.WEB: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking, and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you;

text.KJV: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
text.ASV: if any man is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children that believe, who are not accused of riot or unruly.
text.WEB: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.

text.KJV: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;
text.ASV: For the bishop must be blameless, as God's steward; not self-willed, not soon angry, no brawler, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre;
text.WEB: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward; not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;

text.KJV: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;
text.ASV: but given to hospitality, as lover of good, sober-minded, just, holy, self-controlled;
text.WEB: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled;

text.KJV: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.
text.ASV: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict the gainsayers.
text.WEB: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.

text.KJV: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:
text.ASV: For there are many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision,
text.WEB: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,

text.KJV: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.
text.ASV: whose mouths must be stopped; men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.
text.WEB: whose mouths must be stopped; men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.

text.KJV: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
text.ASV: One of themselves, a prophet of their own, said, Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, idle gluttons.
text.WEB: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”

text.KJV: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;
text.ASV: This testimony is true. For which cause reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,
text.WEB: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

text.KJV: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.
text.ASV: not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.
text.WEB: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

text.KJV: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.
text.ASV: To the pure all things are pure: but to them that are defiled and unbelieving nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.
text.WEB: To the pure, all things are pure; but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

text.KJV: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
text.ASV: They profess that they know God; but by their works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
text.WEB: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.

text.KJV: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:
text.ASV: But speak thou the things which befit the sound doctrine:
text.WEB: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,

text.KJV: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
text.ASV: that aged men be temperate, grave, sober-minded, sound in faith, in love, in patience:
text.WEB: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance:

text.KJV: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;
text.ASV: that aged women likewise be reverent in demeanor, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good;
text.WEB: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good;

text.KJV: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,
text.ASV: that they may train the young women to love their husbands, to love their children,
text.WEB: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,

text.KJV: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.
text.ASV: `to be' sober-minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed:
text.WEB: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.

text.KJV: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.
text.ASV: the younger men likewise exhort to be sober-minded:
text.WEB: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded;

text.KJV: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,
text.ASV: in all things showing thyself an ensample of good works; in thy doctrine `showing' uncorruptness, gravity,
text.WEB: in all things showing yourself an example of good works; in your teaching showing integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,

text.KJV: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.
text.ASV: sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of us.
text.WEB: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned; that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.

text.KJV: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;
text.ASV: `Exhort' servants to be in subjection to their own masters, `and' to be well-pleasing `to them' in all things; not gainsaying;
text.WEB: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters, and to be well-pleasing in all things; not contradicting;

text.KJV: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
text.ASV: not purloining, but showing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
text.WEB: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.

text.KJV: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,
text.ASV: For the grace of God hath appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
text.WEB: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

text.KJV: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
text.ASV: instructing us, to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly and righteously and godly in this present world;
text.WEB: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;

text.KJV: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
text.ASV: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
text.WEB: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ;

text.KJV: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
text.ASV: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a people for his own possession, zealous of good works.
text.WEB: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.

text.KJV: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
text.ASV: These things speak and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
text.WEB: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no man despise you.

text.KJV: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,
text.ASV: Put them in mind to be in subjection to rulers, to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready unto every good work,
text.WEB: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,

text.KJV: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
text.ASV: to speak evil of no man, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all meekness toward all men.
text.WEB: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.

text.KJV: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
text.ASV: For we also once were foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, hating one another.
text.WEB: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

text.KJV: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,
text.ASV: But when the kindness of God our Saviour, and his love toward man, appeared,
text.WEB: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,

text.KJV: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;
text.ASV: not by works `done' in righteousness, which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy he saved us, through the washing of regeneration and renewing of the Holy Spirit,
text.WEB: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,

text.KJV: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;
text.ASV: which he poured out upon us richly, through Jesus Christ our Saviour;
text.WEB: whom he poured out on us richly, through Jesus Christ our Savior;

text.KJV: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
text.ASV: that, being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
text.WEB: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

text.KJV: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.
text.ASV: Faithful is the saying, and concerning these things I desire that thou affirm confidently, to the end that they who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men:
text.WEB: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you affirm confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;

text.KJV: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
text.ASV: but shun foolish questionings, and genealogies, and strifes, and fightings about law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
text.WEB: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

text.KJV: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;
text.ASV: A factious man after a first and second admonition refuse;
text.WEB: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,

text.KJV: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.
text.ASV: knowing that such a one is perverted, and sinneth, being self-condemned.
text.WEB: knowing that such a one is perverted and sins, being self-condemned.

text.KJV: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
text.ASV: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, give diligence to come unto me to Nicopolis: for there I have determined to winter.
text.WEB: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.

text.KJV: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
text.ASV: Set forward Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
text.WEB: Send Zenas, the lawyer, and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.

text.KJV: And let our's also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
text.ASV: And let our `people' also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
text.WEB: Let our people also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they may not be unfruitful.

text.KJV: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
text.ASV: All that are with me salute thee. Salute them that love us in faith. Grace be with you all.
text.WEB: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
